Differential Scanning Calorimeter (DSC)
DSC 300 Caliris Classic
NETZSCH
DSC 300 Caliris ClassicMore options
Webpage 
The DSC 300 Caliris Classic is a compact and robust differential scanning calorimeter with an attractive price-performance ratio. Features include temperature range from -170°C to 600°C, heating/cooling rates of 0.001 to 100 K/min, enthalpy precision of ±0.1% for indium, and optional automatic sample changer for up to 20 samples. Ideal for quality assurance of polymers, food, cosmetics and organic materials with AutoEvaluation and Identify software for automated analysis.
